description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running with the Control Center visible. Market data for SPY is available.

A scalper needs to set up a Level II (Depth of Market) window to monitor the order book for SPY and place orders directly from the window.

Your task:
1. Open a new Level II window from the Control Center (New > Level II).
2. Select 'SPY' as the instrument.
3. Configure the window properties to enable 'Show Order Entry' (or ensure the Order Entry panel is visible at the bottom of the Level II window).
4. Save the workspace to persist this configuration (File > Save Workspace).

Login credentials (if asked): Docker / GymAnything123!
